it describes support for major science and technology projects and research in artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and brain science, and states that the R&D expense deduction ratio for integrated-circuit and industrial-machine-tool firms was raised to 120 percent.","notes":["866.5亿元 equals 86.65 billion yuan, not 866.5 billion yuan."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E005","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":"The report stated that 2023 national general public-budget education expenditure was 4.1242 trillion yuan, up 4.5 percent; assistance funds for people in difficulty were 1,566.83 billion yuan; basic public-health service subsidies were 725.09 billion yuan; and resident medical-insurance subsidies were 3,840 billion yuan.","notes":["41242亿元 equals 4.1242 trillion yuan, not 41.242 trillion yuan.","The excerpt reports expenditure and subsidy amounts; it does not state increases for every listed category."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E007","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":"A 2023 study using panel data from 30 Chinese provinces reported that local-official corruption expanded local-government debt by impairing government-investment efficiency, and that the anti-corruption campaign supported local-government debt management, especially in developed regions.","notes":["The excerpt does not establish that the study was peer-reviewed."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports at least 18 Hong Kong detentions: eight on the eve of the anniversary and another 10 or more on Sunday."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E012","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":"Freedom House described Chinese internet-censorship decisions as arbitrary, opaque, and inconsistent, with no formal avenues for appeal and directives unable to be challenged in court. It reported December 2022 rules requiring technology companies to review social-media posts before publication and 2023 generative-AI rules requiring generated content to embody “core socialist values” and avoid specified prohibited information.","notes":["The excerpt supports that censorship directives cannot be challenged in court, not the broader claim that all censorship rules are legally immune from court challenge."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E016","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":"Freedom House reported that, following the late-2022 zero-COVID protests, authorities used mobile-phone data and surveillance cameras to identify and arrest protesters. It also reported that laws required companies to assist security agencies and retain user data, including without judicial oversight or transparency.","notes":["The excerpt does not state that facial-recognition and Wi-Fi information were used to identify and arrest the protesters.","The excerpt does not mention a new national data bureau announced in March 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E017","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The 500-warhead figure is explicitly attributed to a United States Department of Defense allegation; the delivery-system assessments are attributed to non-governmental sources."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E018","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E019","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":"The G20 New Delhi Declaration of September 2023 stated that the use or threat of use of nuclear weapons was inadmissible and that States must not use force to seek territorial acquisition against another State’s territorial integrity, sovereignty, or political independence.","notes":["The excerpt does not state that China participated in the G20 process."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0007-E020","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
